# Copilot Instructions — p2p_storage

## Pear Runtime conventions

This project targets the Pear Runtime (Holepunch). Before making any change
that touches Pear APIs, workers, window controls, app lifecycle, the `pear`
field in `package.json`, or Hyperswarm/Hypercore/Corestore usage, read
[PEAR.md](../PEAR.md) and follow the canonical patterns documented there.
Flag any deviation explicitly in your plan before editing.
